Limit[n=15]
  Sort[keys=lineitem.quantity DESC]
    Project[lineitem.id AS lineitem_id, orders.id AS order_id, part.name AS part_name, part.retail_price AS retail_price, lineitem.quantity AS quantity, lineitem.extended_price AS extended_price]
      Filter[orders.order_status = 'F' AND part.size > 10]
        Join[kind=inner, cond=lineitem.part_id = part.id]
          Join[kind=inner, cond=lineitem.order_id = orders.id]
            Scan[lineitem]
            Scan[orders]
          Scan[part]
